search_text: published ZDI-07-043 ZDI-CAN-179 Ipswitch IMail IMAP Daemon SUBSCRIBE Stack Overflow Vulnerability 2007-07-19 CVE-2007-2795 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2007-2795 ['Ipswitch'] ['IMail'] This vulnerability allows attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Ipswitch IMail and ICS server. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists due to a lack of bounds checking during the parsing of arguments to the SUBSCRIBE IMAP command sent to the IMAP daemon listening by default on TCP port 143. By providing an overly long string as the argument, an exploitable stack-based buffer overflow occurs. Ipswitch has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. title: Ipswitch IMail IMAP Daemon SUBSCRIBE Stack Overflow Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Ipswitch IMail and ICS server. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists due to a lack of bounds checking during the parsing of arguments to the SUBSCRIBE IMAP command sent to the IMAP daemon listening by default on TCP port 143. By providing an overly long string as the argument, an exploitable stack-based buffer overflow occurs.
